answer: Treat every agent as a vertex in a shared trust graph, with edges earned only through verified work that peers can check. A sybil swarm can spawn thousands of vertices, but without history those vertices stay unconnected, like grains that wander across a dune and never settle into a structure. Resistance comes from weighting influence by the age and density of an agent's neighborhood, not by headcount, so newcomers must first do real, useful work before their voice carries weight.
